adb.title: 找到 adb
adb.fix: 安装 Android platform-tools，或在设置里指定 adb 路径（环境变量 XSCRIPT_ADB / ANDROID_HOME）。

device.title: adb 能看到手机
device.fix: 检查数据线（换一根能传数据的线），手机打开「开发者选项 → USB 调试」；模拟器先 adb connect。然后点「刷新」。

authorized.title: 已允许 USB 调试
authorized.fix: 在手机上的「允许 USB 调试吗？」弹窗里点允许（可勾选「始终允许」）；没有弹窗就拔插一次数据线。

forward.title: 端口转发
forward.fix: adb 转发失败：重启 adb（adb kill-server）后重试，或换个 USB 口。

reach.title: 能连到这个地址
reach.fix: 电脑和手机要在同一个 Wi-Fi，地址和端口以手机首页「开发者地址」为准；访客网络可能开了设备隔离，VPN / 代理也可能拦住局域网地址。也可以改用 USB。

app.title: XScript App 在响应
app.fix: 打开手机上的 XScript，首页「开发者地址」应显示地址而不是「服务未启动」；全新安装要先允许通知权限。省电策略可能把它冻结了。端口不是 9860 时以首页显示为准。

xscript.title: 对方是 XScript
xscript.fix: 这个端口上不是 XScript（可能是别的程序占了端口）：核对端口，并把 App 升级到与电脑端匹配的版本。

pairing.title: 配对码
pairing.fix: 连接后在设备卡片上输入手机首页「开发与连接 → 配对码」显示的配对码。

adb.title: adb found
adb.fix: Install Android platform-tools, or set the adb path in Settings (XSCRIPT_ADB / ANDROID_HOME).

device.title: adb sees the phone
device.fix: Check the cable (it must carry data) and turn on Developer options → USB debugging; for emulators run adb connect first. Then press Refresh.

authorized.title: USB debugging allowed
authorized.fix: Tap Allow in the phone's "Allow USB debugging?" prompt (tick Always allow). No prompt? Unplug and plug the cable back in.

forward.title: Port forward
forward.fix: adb could not forward the port: restart adb (adb kill-server) and try again, or use another USB port.

reach.title: Address reachable
reach.fix: Computer and phone must be on the same Wi-Fi; use the address and port shown on the phone's home screen. Guest networks may isolate devices, and a VPN or proxy can block LAN addresses. USB works too.

app.title: XScript app answers
app.fix: Open XScript on the phone; its home screen should show the developer address, not "service not started". A fresh install needs the notification permission first, and battery saving may have frozen it. Use the port shown there if it is not 9860.

xscript.title: It is XScript
xscript.fix: Something else answers on this port (another program may use it): check the port, and update the app to match this version.

pairing.title: Pairing code
pairing.fix: After connecting, enter the pairing code from the phone's home screen (Development and connection → Pairing code) on the device card.
